purpose: Pre-registered ACL Main evidence matrix for AuthorityKV.
integrity_rules: Report every launched run, including failed gates and runtime errors.
Use identical example IDs, assistant prefix, maximum generation length, and deterministic decoding within each paired comparison.
Do not replace an official baseline with a local approximation.
Do not scale a model-method cell until its FullKV protocol gate passes.
Archive the exact command, environment, source hashes, raw predictions, and judged metrics for every run.

baseline_failure_signal.rationale: The task must expose a non-trivial compression-specific failure.

evidence_axes.name: implementation validity
required: upstream KVPress tests
AuthorityAwarePress unit tests
new-harness FullKV token parity with the legacy runner
one-example integration test for every official press

evidence_axes.name: symmetric multi-model safety
required: same 500 example IDs on all FullKV-gated models
official baselines at 20% and 40%
AuthorityKV and pinning controls at 20% and 40%
category-stratified metrics and paired confidence intervals

evidence_axes.name: budget response
required: 10%, 20%, 40%, and 60% keep-ratio curve
same stratified subset and model across all curve points

evidence_axes.name: safety-utility trade-off
required: hierarchy success and authority reversal rate
benign utility
LongBench utility under the same composition
paired analysis at the example level

evidence_axes.name: systems cost
required: prefill time
decode time and tokens per second
peak device memory
actual retained cache length
median and interquartile range after excluding cold start

evidence_axes.name: adaptive and external validity
required: held-out paraphrase and formatting attacks
provenance/no-provenance ablation
official AgentDojo gate if an open model passes FullKV

required_tests: exact McNemar test for paired binary outcomes
model-stratified and pooled reporting without treating examples as independent across methods

primary_model.scope: all six official methods, exhaustive matched composition variants, and pinning controls at 20% and 40%

cross_family_models.scope: all six official methods plus system-only, all-control, and detector+provenance AuthorityKV core comparisons at 20% and 40%

budget_curve.scope: the three official policies that crossed the pilot failure gate and their detector+provenance AuthorityKV compositions

heldout_adaptive.scope: FullKV gate plus the official policies that crossed the pilot failure gate and matched detector+provenance AuthorityKV at 20% and 40%

external_utility.scope: FullKV, official failing base policies, and the identical Authority composition with no authority spans; report LongBench F1, RULER exact retrieval, and systems telemetry
external_utility.gate_policy: Run compressed methods only when the dataset-specific FullKV threshold passes with zero runtime errors; preserve and report failed gates.

amendments.observed_pilot_fact: Official StreamingLLM and K-Norm crossed the pre-registered failure-signal gate, while official SnapKV did not fail on the pilot.
amendments.change: Add matched Authority-aware, system-only, and all-control compositions for StreamingLLM and K-Norm. Preserve all original SnapKV cells.
amendments.rationale: A defense must be compared on the official base policies that exhibit the measured failure; otherwise a zero-reversal defense cell is not an informative treatment comparison.

amendments.observed_pilot_fact: Official H2O/ObservedAttention crossed the failure-signal gate at both 20% and 40%, while AuthorityKV detector+provenance had zero pilot reversals and full benign utility.
amendments.change: Add matched H2O system-only, all-control, Authority pin, detector, provenance, and detector+provenance compositions. Freeze an exhaustive 500-example primary-model matrix, a 500-example three-control cross-family matrix, and a 120-example four-budget curve.
amendments.rationale: H2O is a closest accepted-paper baseline and requires eager attention, so it is kept as a separate matched run group with the same examples and budgets.

amendments.observed_pilot_fact: At 20% keep, the all-control pinning control exceeded the exact KV budget on all five multi-tier pilot examples because its protected set was larger than the retained cache.
amendments.change: Represent a protected-set budget violation as a typed infeasible outcome, report feasibility as its own denominator, exclude infeasible cells from conditional success rates and paired tests, and continue to preserve every attempted cell.
amendments.rationale: A mathematically infeasible blanket-pinning control is evidence about the baseline's applicability, not a model runtime failure or a valid empty generation. Separating feasibility prevents both silent relaxation of the fixed budget and biased scoring.
